name: Architecture vault check
responsibility: Checks one vault: whether its configuration is valid, which policy applies, and what its model or a named state says about its own structure
description: checkArchitectureVault answers the vault check whole, so the server's /api/vault/check route and the layout measurements call one operation. A model that cannot be read answers its refusal as errors.

outgoing.label: read the model or the named state
the configuration and the policy it applies
